name: local-workflow
description: Project-agnostic plugin for local development work. Its end-to-end command is `build`, which plans, writes, verifies and commits a task on your machine — renamed from `execute` so it is no longer confusable with github-workflow's `execute`, which runs the full pull-request loop. Also provides structured coding methodology, architecture design and audit, feature discovery and plan validation, user story writing, PR descriptions, support documentation, and tone-matched correspondence. No GitHub or platform dependencies required.
